title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 12 in F minor

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Alto: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Bass: a figure from the subject (4 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars.
sections.leads: From F minor to A♭ major

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Alto: a figure from the subject (4 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Bass: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars.
sections.leads: From E♭ major to F minor; perfect cadence in C major at bar 40

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted (3 times) and a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a fifth every bar.
sections.leads: Between two statements in F minor

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Alto: a figure from the subject (7 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Bass: a figure from the subject (8 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars.
sections.leads: From F minor to B♭ minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in B♭ minor (Soprano); Subject in F minor (Alto)
Coda
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in F minor at bar 85

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from the subject (5 times), in a sequence rising by a step every half bar.
